resources.string: Climate and comfort through CarPlay Ultra
Enable climate and vehicle controls together with MFi4 authentication and the Ultra profile. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.
Writes require WRITE_CANBUS. Cabin sensor and MAX A/C are not advertised. Commands run only in response to an explicit iPhone request.

Debug test. Applies at the next CarPlay connection. Accepts fileTransfer offered by iPhone and only records what it sends, without processing the package or running vehicle commands. UI Sync works independently of this switch. May interrupt the CarPlay session: turn it off if CarPlay stops connecting.
